title: The reactivation confirmation from the part window has one line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an inactive part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Active under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • Active is picked.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation is titled "Activate part?": it shows part A's part number followed by its description, then "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more (no "Existing records" line and no "Stock, cost of goods" line), then the "Note (Optional)" field.
  • The Activate button is blue.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes and part A stays on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R7: “For a reactivation from the part dialog, the confirmation states "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more.”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R11: “The confirm button reads "Deactivate" in red for a deactivation and "Activate" in blue for a reactivation. Cancel sits to its left.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
